chunk_policy: Prefer the last whitespace boundary in the second half of the bounded window; otherwise split at the character limit. Preserve every character and original offsets; no overlap or truncation.
non_graph_segments: Whitespace or U+FFFD-only segments are retained in the document index with a reason; no fake token embeddings.
limitations: Independent chunk graphs do not preserve syntax or security relations across chunk boundaries.
A forced boundary can split an unusually long token; it is recorded explicitly.
Chunk DOCUMENT nodes represent chunks, not new CVEs. Pool chunks within documents and documents within sources.
The source masks and retrospective-text limitations of CD02 remain unchanged.
Unembedded structural/whitespace/replacement-character nodes retain explicit masks; missing ordinary-token embeddings fail the build.
No training or test graph construction is performed. The fusion runner is a separate stage.
